questions.domain: 領域 4：負責任 AI 指南 (Guidelines for Responsible AI)

question_text.zh: 一家公司每个季度都会进行预测,以决定如何优化运营来满足预期需求。该公司使用机器学习( ML)模型来进行这些预测。 一名 AI 从业者正在撰写一份关于已训练 ML 模型的报告,以向公司利益相关者提供透明度和可解释性。 AI 从业者应在报告中包含什么内容,以满足透明度和可解释性要求?
question_text.en: A company makes forecasts each quarter to decide how to optimize operations to meet expected demand. The company uses ML models to make these forecasts. An AI practitioner is writing a report about the trained ML models to provide transparency and explainability to company stakeholders. What should the AI practitioner include in the report to meet the transparency and explainability requirements?

A.zh: 用于模型训练的代码
A.en: Code for model training

B.zh: 部分依赖图( PDP
B.en: Partial dependence plots (PDPs)

C.zh: 用于训练的样本数据
C.en: Sample data for training

D.zh: 模型收敛表
D.en: Model convergence tables

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，代码更多提供 “实现透明度 /可复现性 ”,但对业务干系人通常不可读,也不直接解释 “模型为什么这么预测 ”。 结论:不满足 “解释性 ”的核心诉求,通常不是最佳答案
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: What should the AI practitioner include in the report to meet the transparency and explainability requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Partial dependence plots (PDPs).

B.zh: 正確。原因是，点:PDP能展示某个输入特征变化时,模型预测结果如何变化(平均边际影响)。 契合题意:用于向干系人说明关键驱动因素及其影响方向 /趋势,直接支撑 “透明性与可解释性 ”。 结论:最符合要求的内容
B.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: What should the AI practitioner include in the report to meet the transparency and explainability requirements?

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，提供样本数据可能涉及隐私 /合规⻛险;即便脱敏,也更多是 “数据透明度 ”,并不能直接解释模型决策逻辑。 补充:报告中可以描述数据来源、分布、特征工程、偏差与代表性,但 “给样本数据 ”本身不是解释模型的方法。 结论:不如 PDP直接满足 “可解释性 ”
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: What should the AI practitioner include in the report to meet the transparency and explainability requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Partial dependence plots (PDPs).

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，收敛表通常是训练过程的技术指标( loss随迭代变化等),反映训练是否稳定,而非解释预测依据。 结论:有助于技术审计,但不是面向干系人的解释性核心材料
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: What should the AI practitioner include in the report to meet the transparency and explainability requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Partial dependence plots (PDPs).

answer_text.zh: B. 部分依赖图( PDP
answer_text.en: B. Partial dependence plots (PDPs)

discussion.zh: 來源社群投票分布為 B 98%。討論重點是比較各選項是否真正滿足題目主要需求；最終答案依來源解析與技術判斷採用 B。
discussion.en: The source community vote distribution is B 98%. The discussion focuses on whether each option satisfies the primary requirement; the final answer follows the source analysis and technical reasoning: B.

questions.domain: 領域 2：生成式 AI 基礎 (Fundamentals of GenAI)

question_text.zh: 一家律师事务所希望通过使用大型语言模型( LLMs)构建一个 AI 应用程序。该应用程序将读取法律文件并从文件中提取要点。 哪个解决方案满足这些要求?
question_text.en: A law firm wants to build an AI application by using large language models (LLMs). The application will read legal documents and extract key points from the documents. Which solution meets these requirements?

A.zh: 构建一个自动化的命名实体识别系统。
A.en: Build an automatic named entity recognition system.

B.zh: 创建一个推荐引擎。
B.en: Create a recommendation engine.

C.zh: 开发一个摘要聊天机器人。
C.en: Develop a summarization chatbot.

D.zh: 开发一个多语言翻译系统。
D.en: Develop a multi-language translation system.

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，原因: NER的输出通常是 “实体 +类别(如当事人、法院、日期、金额、法条引用)。它能做”信息抽取的一部分,但题目要的是 “提取关键点 ”,关键点往往是跨句的结论、争议焦点、义务责任、⻛险条款等,超出 NER的能力边界。 什么时候会选它:如果题目要求 “从合同中抽取当事人、金额、日期、地址 ”等结构化字段, NER更合适
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is C. Develop a summarization chatbot..

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，原因:推荐引擎用于个性化推荐(内容 /商品/文档 /案例等),不解决 “读取文档并提炼关键点 ”的自然语言理解与总结问题
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is C. Develop a summarization chatbot..

C.zh: 正確。原因是，原因:摘要聊天机器人可以让用戶上传 /提供法律文档内容, LLM 对文本进行摘要与要点提炼 (例如按项目符号输出关键点、争议焦点、关键条款、结论)。这与“读取法律文档并提取关键点 ”高度一致。 备注:即使不是 “聊天 ”形态,本质能力仍是 summarization / key point extraction,最贴合题意
C.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which solution meets these requirements?

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，原因:翻译解决跨语言转换,不等同于提取关键点。除非题目强调 “把法律文件翻译成另一种语言 ”,否则不匹配
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is C. Develop a summarization chatbot..

answer_text.zh: C. 开发一个摘要聊天机器人。
answer_text.en: C. Develop a summarization chatbot.

questions.domain: 領域 1：AI 和 ML 基礎 (Fundamentals of AI and ML)

question_text.zh: 一家企业希望根据基因特征将人类基因分类为 20 个类别。该企业需要一种 ML 算法来记录模型的内部机制如何影响输出。 哪种 ML 算法满足这些要求?
question_text.en: A company wants to classify human genes into 20 categories based on gene characteristics. The company needs an ML algorithm to document how the inner mechanism of the model affects the output. Which ML algorithm meets these requirements?

A.zh: 决策树
A.en: Decision trees

B.zh: 线性回归
B.en: Linear regression

C.zh: 逻辑回归
C.en: Logistic regression

D.zh: 神经网络
D.en: Neural networks

A.zh: 正確。原因是，20类分类: 支持。决策树天然支持多分类(叶子节点输出类别 /类别分布)。 可解释性: 很强。可以把每次分裂的特征与阈值、信息增益 /基尼指数等记录下来;对单个预测还可以展示从根到叶的决策路径,非常适合 “document inner mechanism”。 结论: 满足题意,是最贴合题干 “内部机制如何影响输出 ”的选择
A.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which ML algorithm meets these requirements?

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，20类分类: 不适合。线性回归主要用于预测连续值(回归问题),不是分类算法。 可解释性: 虽然系数可解释,但任务类型不匹配。 结论: 错误
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which ML algorithm meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is A. Decision trees.

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，20类分类: 可以。可通过 One-vs-Rest或Softmax(多项逻辑回归)扩展到 20类。 可解释性: 较强。可以通过特征权重(系数)解释各特征如何影响类别概率(例如对 log-odds的影响)。 为什么可能不是最佳: 题干强调 “document how the inner mechanism... affects the output”,很多考试语境下更倾向选择更直观可视化、 规则路径明确的模型(决策树)。逻辑回归虽可解释,但需要理解 log-odds/概率映射,对 “内部机制 ”直观性不如决策树路径。 结论: 可解释且可多分类,但在本题语境下通常不如决策树贴切;不选
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which ML algorithm meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is A. Decision trees.

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，20类分类: 支持(例如 softmax输出 20维)。 可解释性: 弱。通常被认为是 “黑盒 ”,难以直接 “document inner mechanism”来说明每个内部单元如何导致输出(虽然有可解释 AI方法,但不属于其天然可解释性)。 结论: 不满足 “需要记录内部机制影响输出 ”的核心要求;错误
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which ML algorithm meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is A. Decision trees.

answer_text.zh: A. 决策树
answer_text.en: A. Decision trees

discussion.zh: 來源社群投票分布為 A 100%。討論重點是比較各選項是否真正滿足題目主要需求；最終答案依來源解析與技術判斷採用 A。
discussion.en: The source community vote distribution is A 100%. The discussion focuses on whether each option satisfies the primary requirement; the final answer follows the source analysis and technical reasoning: A.

question_text.zh: 一家公司构建了一个图像分类模型,用于从植物叶片的照片中预测植物疾病。该公司想要评估该模型正确分类了多少张图像。 公司应该使用哪种评估指标来衡量模型的性能?
question_text.en: A company has built an image classification model to predict plant diseases from photos of plant leaves. The company wants to evaluate how many images the model classified correctly. Which evaluation metric should the company use to measure the model's performance?

A.zh: R² 决定系数
A.en: R-squared score

B.zh: 准确率
B.en: Accuracy

C.zh: 均方根误差（RMSE）
C.en: Root mean squared error (RMSE)

D.zh: 学习率
D.en: Learning rate

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，错误 R-squared(决定系数)主要用于回归问题,衡量模型解释方差的能力。 本题是图像分类(预测疾病类别),不适用
A.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which evaluation metric should the company use to measure the model's performance? The source-supported choice is B. Accuracy.

B.zh: 正確。原因是，正确 Accuracy衡量整体预测正确的比例,正符合 “有多少图片被正确分类 ”。 在类别相对均衡、且关注整体正确率时, Accuracy是最直观的选择
B.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which evaluation metric should the company use to measure the model's performance?

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，错误 RMSE用于回归问题,衡量预测数值与真实数值之间误差的平方平均再开方。 分类输出是类别标签,不是连续数值;不匹配本题目标
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which evaluation metric should the company use to measure the model's performance? The source-supported choice is B. Accuracy.

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，错误 Learning rate是训练超参数 (优化器步⻓),不是评估指标。 不能用于衡量 “分类正确了多少张图片 ”
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which evaluation metric should the company use to measure the model's performance? The source-supported choice is B. Accuracy.

answer_text.zh: B. 准确率
answer_text.en: B. Accuracy

discussion.zh: 來源社群投票分布為 B 100%。討論重點是比較各選項是否真正滿足題目主要需求；最終答案依來源解析與技術判斷採用 B。
discussion.en: The source community vote distribution is B 100%. The discussion focuses on whether each option satisfies the primary requirement; the final answer follows the source analysis and technical reasoning: B.

question_text.zh: 一家公司正在使用预训练的大型语言模型( LLM)来构建一个用于产品推荐的聊天机器人。该公司需要 LLM的输出内容简短且以特定语言书写。 哪种解决方案可以使 LLM的响应质量符合公司的期望?
question_text.en: A company is using a pre-trained large language model (LLM) to build a chatbot for product recommendations. The company needs the LLM outputs to be short and written in a specific language. Which solution will align the LLM response quality with the company's expectations?

A.zh: 调整提示。
A.en: Adjust the prompt.

B.zh: 选择不同大小的 LLM。
B.en: Choose an LLM of a different size.

C.zh: 增加温度。
C.en: Increase the temperature.

D.zh: 增加 Top K值。
D.en: Increase the Top K value.

A.zh: 正確。原因是，调整提示( Prompt Engineering)是优化 LLM输出的最直接和有效的方法。通过设计更具体的提示,可以引导模型生成符合预期的输出,例如控制语言、⻓度和内容质量
A.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which solution will align the LLM response quality with the company's expectations?

B.zh: 錯誤。原因是，选择不同大小的 LLM可能会影响模型的性能和生成质量,但无法直接解决输出语言和⻓度的问题。问题的核心在于如何调整现有模型的输出,而不是更换模型
B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will align the LLM response quality with the company's expectations? The source-supported choice is A. Adjust the prompt..

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，温度参数控制生成文本的随机性。增加温度会使输出更加随机化,可能导致生成的内容不符合预期的语言和⻓度要求
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will align the LLM response quality with the company's expectations? The source-supported choice is A. Adjust the prompt..

D.zh: 錯誤。原因是，Top K值控制模型在生成文本时从概率最高的 K个词中选择。增加 Top K值可能会导致输出更加多样化,但无法保证语言和⻓度的控制
D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which solution will align the LLM response quality with the company's expectations? The source-supported choice is A. Adjust the prompt..

answer_text.zh: A. 调整提示。
answer_text.en: A. Adjust the prompt.

question_text.en: A company uses Amazon SageMaker for its ML pipeline in a production environment. The company has large input data sizes up to 1 GB and processing times up to 1 hour. The company needs near real-time latency. Which SageMaker inference option meets these requirements?

A.en: Real-time inference

B.zh: 无服务器推理
B.en: Serverless inference

C.zh: 异步推理
C.en: Asynchronous inference

D.zh: 批量转换
D.en: Batch transform

B.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which SageMaker inference option meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is C. Asynchronous inference.

C.zh: 正確。原因是，异步推理专为处理大数据量和⻓时间处理任务而设计,同时支持近实时的响应。此选项符合题目要求
C.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which SageMaker inference option meets these requirements?

D.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which SageMaker inference option meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is C. Asynchronous inference.

question_text.en: A company is using domain-specific models. The company wants to avoid creating new models from the beginning. The company instead wants to adapt pre-trained models to create models for new, related tasks. Which ML strategy meets these requirements?

A.zh: 增加 epochs数量。
A.en: Increase the number of epochs.

B.zh: 使用迁移学习。
B.en: Use transfer learning.

C.zh: 减少 epochs数量。
C.en: Decrease the number of epochs.

D.zh: 使用无监督学习。
D.en: Use unsupervised learning.

A.zh: 錯誤。原因是，增加 epochs数量仅仅是训练模型的一种方式,但它并不能解决如何利用预训练模型的问题。此选项与题目要求无关

B.en: Correct. Choosing this option directly addresses the source-confirmed requirement: Which ML strategy meets these requirements?

C.zh: 錯誤。原因是，减少 epochs数量可能会导致模型训练不足,与题目要求无关
C.en: Incorrect. This option addresses a different task or misses a key constraint in: Which ML strategy meets these requirements? The source-supported choice is B. Use transfer learning..

question_text.zh: 一家公司正在构建一个解决方案,用于生成防护眼镜的图像。该解决方案必须具有高准确性,并且必须最大限度地减少错误标注的 ⻛险。 哪种解决方案可以满足这些要求?
question_text.en: A company is building a solution to generate images for protective eyewear. The solution must have high accuracy and must minimize the risk of incorrect annotations. Which solution will meet these requirements?

A.zh: 通过使用 Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth Plus进行人工验证
A.en: Human-in-the-loop validation by using Amazon SageMaker Ground Truth Plus

B.zh: 通过使用 Amazon Bedrock知识库进行数据增强
B.en: Data augmentation by using an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base

C.zh: 通过使用 Amazon Rekognition进行图像识别
C.en: Image recognition by using Amazon Rekognition
